page.overview:
Who is Dr. Hardy?

Dr. Hardy was a fictional scientist responsible for the development of the nanoweapon, "Heracles". He employed by the British Secret Intelligence Service (SIS/MI6). He was portrayed by Hugh Dennis, the character appeared in the 2021 James Bond film No Time to Die.

A scientist specialising in genetics and nanorobotics, Dr. Hardy had been an integral part of a decade-long project to develop a DNA-targeting assassination nanoweapon for SIS, code-named "Heracles". Circa 2020, the London laboratory, where he worked, was raided by the criminal organisation SPECTRE, to steal the Heracles. He was shot after he and Dr. Valdo Obruchev gave the bioweapon to Primo.
